subject.title: fix: keep tail alive and replay timed-out messages

question: Should the fail-closed timeout, durable private spool, automatic import, exact create/update/delete replay, and replay-only CLI become Discrawl's supported tail recovery contract?
rationale: The implementation is technically mature, but it creates persistent files and new startup, replay, and delete semantics that require explicit ownership rather than being inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Accept the full recovery contract
options.body: Remove the changelog edit, let exact-head CI finish, and merge with the bounded spool and replay behavior as the supported design.

options.title: Narrow the operational surface
options.body: Retain exact durable failure recording while deferring automatic replay or the replay-only CLI to a separate decision.

options.title: Pause the contract change
options.body: Keep the PR open or close it if maintainers do not want persistent fallback artifacts and fail-closed replay semantics in core.

recommendation.title: Accept the full recovery contract
recommendation.body: Remove the changelog edit, let exact-head CI finish, and merge with the bounded spool and replay behavior as the supported design.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the final design-tightening and fail-closed commits and have the strongest current-history connection to the affected cancellation and storage paths.
